GLOBAÏA's AI Risks Observatory

It's a nonprofit project with 30+ interactive visualizations tracking the AI race, including capability benchmarks, compute scaling, safety funding, risk taxonomy, and governance gaps. It includes a "State of the Frontier" dashboard of live capability measures such as the Intelligence Index, autonomous task length, and training compute. It also has an AI Incident Record.
